findings.one_line: The coefficient-height proof drops a product term: (12) contains Q_theta(ell) P_theta(E0), a product of two network polynomials with up to h monomials each, so after simplex substitution its collected coefficients need not be bounded by 2h as claimed; repair the height/output bound (e.g. account for the h^2 product expansion) before asserting the stated exact bound.
